metadata.title: Analytics - delitip
metadata.description: Platform-wide usage and revenue overview for delitip staff.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Platform-wide usage and revenue, across every business on delitip.
analytics.otherCurrencies: Also active in {currencies} - figures above show {currency} only, the platform's largest currency by tip volume in this range.

usersTrend.title: Users created
usersTrend.summary: {count, plural, one {# new user} other {# new users}} in this range.
usersTrend.empty: No users created in this range.

revenueTrend.title: Revenue
revenueTrend.empty: No revenue recorded in this range.

feeBreakdown.title: Fee breakdown
feeBreakdown.description: How each completed tip splits between the platform, the payment processor, and what stores actually get to distribute.

totalTip.label: Total tip
totalTip.explanation: The full amount customers paid across completed tips in this range, before any fees are deducted.

platformFee.label: Platform fee
platformFee.explanation: delitip's commission, taken as a percentage of each tip at checkout.

platformFeePercent.label: Platform fee %
platformFeePercent.explanation: Platform fee as a share of total tip revenue in this range (weighted by tip size, not averaged per tip).

paymentFee.label: Payment fee
paymentFee.explanation: The card/payment processor's transaction fee, estimated at checkout and reconciled once the processor confirms it.

paymentFeePercent.label: Payment fee %
paymentFeePercent.explanation: Payment processor fee as a share of total tip revenue in this range (weighted by tip size, not averaged per tip).

totalFee.label: Total fee
totalFee.explanation: Platform fee + payment fee combined - everything taken out of tips before stores and employees get paid.

totalFeePercent.label: Total fee %
totalFeePercent.explanation: Combined fee as a share of total tip revenue in this range (weighted by tip size, not averaged per tip).

storeAmountNet.label: Store amount net
storeAmountNet.explanation: What's left after platform and payment fees are deducted - the pool each store then splits with its employees per its distribution rule.

revenueSplit.title: Revenue split
revenueSplit.description: Where completed tip revenue ends up, in this range.
revenueSplit.empty: No distributed revenue in this range.

metadata.title: VAT Simulator - delitip
metadata.description: Simulate the tip → platform → store/employee accounting and VAT flow.

vatSimulator.title: VAT Simulator
vatSimulator.description: Simulate invoices, VAT, and platform profit for a single tip.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Net tip amount (before VAT), plus the platform and processor fees taken out of it.
inputs.tipAmountHint: What the customer tips, before VAT.
inputs.platformFeeHint: % of the tip, taken out of it - not added on top. = {amount}
inputs.processorFeeHint: e.g. Viva Wallet's cut - % of the tip plus a fixed amount per transaction. = {amount}
inputs.reverseCharge: Customer is B2B with reverse charge
inputs.reverseChargeHint: Platform's sale gets 0% VAT; the customer self-accounts for it.

vatSimulator.invalid: The platform fee and processor fee together exceed the tip, so the store/employee net amount would be negative. Lower the fees or raise the tip before reading the results below.

documents.title: Invoices & receipts
documents.description: Every document this flow generates, net → VAT → total.

storeToPlatform.title: Store/Employee → Platform
storeToPlatform.note: Invoice for the net amount owed to the store/employee

processorToPlatform.title: Processor → Platform
processorToPlatform.note: Invoice for the payment processing fee

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Platform profit and the VAT due to the state.

vatSimulator.disclaimer: This is a simplified simulation. Consult your accountant for real accounting.

metadata.title: App Config - delitip
metadata.description: Platform-wide commission, fee estimate and payout settings.

appConfig.title: App Config
appConfig.description: Platform-wide finance and payout settings. Changes apply to future tips and payouts only.
appConfig.loadError: Could not load the app config.

tip_platform_commission_percentage.label: Platform commission (%)
tip_platform_commission_percentage.hint: Taken from each tip. Snapshotted per transaction, so past tips are never recalculated.

tip_processor_fee_estimate_percentage.label: Processor fee estimate (%)
tip_processor_fee_estimate_percentage.hint: Provisional percentage used for display until the real fee is settled.

vat_rate_percentage.label: VAT rate (%)
vat_rate_percentage.hint: Added on top of every tip at checkout. 0 means no VAT.

payout_hold_window_hours.label: Payout hold window (hours)
payout_hold_window_hours.hint: How long a tip is held before it becomes payable.

platform_legal_name.label: Legal name
platform_legal_name.hint: The company name stores must put on the invoice.

platform_vat_number.label: VAT number
platform_vat_number.hint: Also used to check the invoice is addressed to the platform.

payout_invoice_instructions.label: Instructions for stores
payout_invoice_instructions.hint: Free text, e.g. where to also email the PDF or which invoice series to use.

invoices.title: Payout invoices
invoices.description: When on, a store's own share is only paid after it uploads an invoice to the platform and an admin approves it. Staff paid directly to their own IBAN are not affected.

required.label: Require an invoice before paying stores
required.hint: Replaces "Pay out now" with "Request payout" for the store's money.

aiCheck.label: Read invoices automatically
aiCheck.hint: Uses OpenAI to extract the total, VAT numbers and date and flag mismatches for the admin. Requires an OpenAI key on the API.

invoices.shownToStores: - shown to every store when it requests a payout

connected.label: Connected-account payouts (Viva)
connected.hint: Shows "Connect with Viva" to stores. Turn on only once real Viva platform credentials exist and a sandbox onboarding has been verified.

storeOnly.label: Transfer tips to stores only
storeOnly.hint: Tips are paid to the store, which hands staff their share itself. Hides the direct staff payout actions.

errors.needAttention: Some values need your attention. Please check them and try again.

toasts.savedDescription: New values apply to future tips and payouts.
toasts.failedDescription: Check the values and try again.
